summary: Autonomous Scheduled Social Posting (autopost) feature fully verified — backend (11/11 pytest pass including end-to-end mission run) + frontend Playwright (Sessions panel, autopost quick-action, AutopostStatusPill, all 3 tabs render clean — no Pencil ReferenceError regression). Critical regression guard PASSED: scheduling an autopost with fake cookies → mission ran, mapped to autopost_status='failed' (not 'posted'), post.status NOT 'published', autopost_error populated.

minor.issue: Response shape changed to {posts: [...]} from earlier flat list — older test_social_posts.py + any FE consumer that still expects a flat array will break. Doc this in the API contract.

issues: The Platform <select> uses the browser-native dropdown rather than the shadcn/Radix Select used elsewhere on the page — inconsistent UX and styling on dark theme.
The 'pending' pill text reads 'Autopost pending· twitter' — missing space between the dot and platform label (cosmetic). Status pill also overlaps the date timestamp on narrow card widths.

action_items: (Cosmetic) SocialPage.js — fix the 'pending·' → 'pending ·' spacing in AutopostStatusPill.
(Optional) Replace native <select> in SocialSessionsPanel with the shadcn Select for visual consistency with the rest of the page.
(Optional) Document the {posts: [...]} response wrapper for /social/draft in the OpenAPI / FE types — previous iteration tests hard-coded the flat list shape.
critical_code_review_comments: social_autopost.py _drive_and_finalize correctly maps PUBLISHED:/FAILED:/no-prefix outcomes; verified end-to-end with a fake-cookie run that produced mission summary 'FAILED: login session expired …' → post.autopost_status='failed', post.status remained 'queued', autopost_error populated. ✓
_serialize_session() never returns the raw storage_state dict; verified by asserting the secret cookie value (FAKE_SECRET_DO_NOT_LEAK) is absent from POST/GET response bodies. ✓

rehydrate_autopost_jobs >1h staleness branch is reachable but not directly unit-tested — would require manipulating db.social_posts.scheduled_for back in time. Low risk because the same _register_job code path is exercised live, but consider an isolated unit test.

browser_tools.register_mission_storage_state() pop-on-consume is good hygiene — unit-test added confirms the dict round-trip; the actual injection into the Playwright context happens inside _get_or_create_mission_page (line 225) which we did NOT exercise without a real browser run, but the live mission test indirectly proves it (the agent received the storage_state and reported login wall behaviour exactly as designed).

social_autopost.py cancel endpoint sets autopost_status='cancelled' only when previously pending/running — verified. Edge case: cancelling a post whose autopost was never scheduled returns autopost_status='' (empty), which is fine but consider returning 200 with a no-op marker so the FE knows nothing changed.
server.py is now 3586+ lines — the social_autopost router was correctly factored out (good); same pattern should be applied to the missions and orgs blocks.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (sessions panel, autopost quick-action, status pill, 3-tab render — all clean)

test_credentials: Fresh user TEST_autopost_<uuid>@example.com registered each backend run. FE smoke ran against the seeded standing account autopost-test-1777661963@example.com / testtest123 / org_id=69f4f8199304a5a0df27f750.
seed_data_creation: Each backend module run registers a fresh user + creates TEST_AutopostOrg_<rand>; one TEST_ draft seeded per scenario. FE flow seeded one extra draft on the standing org and scheduled it +30min — quick-action then enabled autopost, leaving an 'Autopost pending · twitter' post that will fire a Mission ~30 min from now (will resolve to failed because no real cookies).
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_social_autopost.py uses pytest.mark.slow for the ~2-minute end-to-end mission run; pass `-m 'not slow'` to skip it in fast iterations or `-m slow` for the regression-critical E2E. The /social/draft endpoint now returns {posts: [...]} not a flat list — older test_social_posts.py was written against the flat shape, may need a re-run to confirm it still passes (handles via _load_backend_url helper). The backend correctly enforces FE/BE invariants: cookies never leak (verified with grep on response.text), 422s for unsupported platforms (instagram/tiktok/youtube), 422 for past scheduled_for, 422 for empty storage_state. Pencil import bug is fixed — no ReferenceError on Published tab.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional bugs found. Two cosmetic issues only (pill spacing + native select).
